meta.geography: Colorado counties (5-digit FIPS); each county carries its HUD FMR area
meta.rent_basis: Gross rent: the limit covers rent plus the utility allowance for any tenant-paid utilities (24 CFR 92.252).

rules.high_home: Lesser of the FMR and 30% of income at 65% AMI (NAHA section 215).
rules.low_home: 30% of income at 50% AMI, capped by the High HOME rent.

meta.not_included: HOME income limits, the lesser-of-HOME-and-LIHTC rule for mixed projects, and SRO limits are not in this file.
